# Design — Portable Fallback

Use for brand and graphic design, not product UI implementation.

## Load progressively

- `references/deliverable-routing.md` — logo/identity/banner/poster/icon/social/slides.
- `references/brand-system.md` — identity principles, tokens and system coherence.
- `references/asset-production.md` — production constraints and exports.
- `references/design-review.md` — critique visual output against communication goals.

## Workflow

1. Define communication goal, audience, medium and required applications.
2. Audit existing brand assets/history/constraints.
3. Select the correct deliverable workflow.
4. Establish a small set of visual principles before producing assets.
5. Explore materially different directions rather than cosmetic variants.
6. Select a direction based on communication fit and production constraints.
7. Build reusable typography/color/grid/shape/image rules where the scope needs a system.
8. Produce representative assets.
9. Review at real sizes/media and iterate from rendered evidence.
10. Document reusable rules only when the work must scale beyond one asset.

Do not generate a large brand manual when the task only needs one bounded asset.
